description: This programme integrates people-centric skills, ethical use of technology, and digital confidence to ensure responsible and effective adoption of AI for socio-economic advancement. Developed in collaboration with Intel Technologies India Pvt. Ltd., it aims to equip the future workforce with essential Artificial Intelligence competencies for employability in a rapidly evolving digital economy.Purpose:Build technical confidence in AI: Simplify Artificial Intelligence concepts and empower learners to independently acquire and apply AI skills.Improve employability for AI-driven roles: Strengthen technical capabilities, career readiness, and social skills required for emerging AI-based job opportunities.Provide employment-focused evidence: Enable learners to create AI project solutions that demonstrate real industrial or social impact, supporting their employability credentials.
awardingBodyName: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology
